Claude Opus 5 is the most capable model in the family. Its API model id is `claude-opus-5`.

Pricing is $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens.
Cache reads cost $0.50 per million tokens.
Claude Opus 5 has a context window of 1,000,000 tokens.
Responses can use up to 128,000 max output tokens, shared between thinking and text.
The effort parameter supports low, medium, high, xhigh, and max.
The default effort is high.
Extended thinking is on by default.
Disabling thinking is supported at effort high or lower; requests that disable thinking at xhigh or max return a 400 error.
